name: rsvper
description: A self-hostable wedding invite and RSVP app for Cloudflare Workers + D1.

scripts.dev: node scripts/build.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run db:migrate:remote && wrangler deploy

DB.description: Stores your settings, invites and replies. Created for you automatically: just pick a name.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: The password you'll use to sign in at `/admin`. **At least 12 characters**; a few random words works well. You can change it later in Settings.

SESSION_SECRET.description: A long random string that keeps admin sign-ins secure. **At least 32 characters.** Generate one with `openssl rand -base64 32`, or use a password manager's generator. You never need to type it again.

ADMIN_AUTH_MODE.description: Leave as `password`. Set to `access` only if you protect `/admin` with [Cloudflare Access](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/) and also set `ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN` and `ACCESS_AUD`.

TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY.description: Optional. You can add [Turnstile](https://developers.cloudflare.com/turnstile/) keys later from the admin instead.

TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY.description: Optional. You can add Turnstile keys later from the admin instead.

ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN.description: Only for `ADMIN_AUTH_MODE=access`: your Zero Trust team domain, e.g. `yourteam.cloudflareaccess.com`.

ACCESS_AUD.description: Only for `ADMIN_AUTH_MODE=access`: the Application Audience (AUD) tag of your Access application.
